nina: Starting change-window deploy for notif-service v4.2.0 in eu-west. plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 20m. Watch p95, 5xx, and downstream API 502s. pinging @oncall.

deploy-bot: [deploy] notif-service v4.2.0 -> canary 10% (eu-west). id=deploy-1819998888. preflight ok.

omar: loading SLO dash. baseline p95=180ms. current p95=195ms (+8%). 5xx=0.02%. downstream auth 502 rate baseline 0.01%.

alert-bot: RULE: eu-west.notif.p95_delta > +10%? no (current +8%). RULE: eu-west.downstream.auth.502 > 0.2%? no.

nina: warmup window 6m. if p95 > +12% or 5xx > 0.5% we pin EU to v4.1.8. pin cmd: `deploy-bot pin-version notif-service v4.1.8 --scope eu-west --reason "canary regression"`

omar: small tail blip at t+9m: p95 briefly +14% for 90s; no 5xx but downstream 502s ticked to 0.6% in the same window.

alert-bot: ALERT: eu-west.downstream.auth.502 spike -> aggregated 0.6% over 2m. recommending hold.

deploy-bot: canary pause requested by alert-bot. traffic frozen at 10%. backoff timer started.

nina: hold. starting triage with infra-auth team. omar, grab a trace sample and post quick correlation.

omar: trace snippet: `notif->auth proxy 502 at t=+9m; retries show increased latency -> client timeout -> p95 tail`. Posting short trace link: https://traces.redwood/t/1819998888

pm-sylvia: FYI notified customer success for EU customers. Holding messaging until we decide pin vs retry.

nina: interim mitigation: apply runtime override to increase upstream retry count from 1 -> 2 for canary only. command: `deploy-bot runtime-override notif.retry.count=2 --scope canary`.

deploy-bot: runtime override applied (id=cfg-1819998888).

alert-bot: after override: downstream 502s dropped to 0.15%, p95 back to +5%.

nina: good signal. we'll keep paused for 10m to watch for recurrence. if stable, resume to 50%. if 502s reappear >0.5% we will pin to v4.1.8 and notify.

omar: logging the follow-up in the release notes draft and will attach traces.

nina: thanks all. will update in 8m. :thumbsup:
